about: Ready companies offered at the start of a campaign. Each is a different way through the same troubles.

companies.label: The fellowship
companies.note: Ranger, warrior and cleric: reads beasts, picks locks, mends wounds and lays the dead to rest. Steady.

companies.label: Delvers
companies.note: Thief, warrior and mage: locks, traps, brawn, digging and lore, with spells to end a fight. No healer.

companies.label: Pilgrims
companies.note: Cleric, monk and bard: healing, the rites of the dead, climbing and lore. Gentle with beasts only by luck.

companies.label: Outriders
companies.note: Ranger, thief and warrior: tracking, stealth, locks and brawn. Quick and quiet; no spells at all.

companies.label: Old hands
companies.note: Warrior, cleric and mage of twelfth level, back in the Varrow after twenty years, with a jar of noonlight between them. For the high country: Brack, the deeps and the Unlit.
